breakdown.description: The torque-induced arc load is replaced by a fixed global-x traction instead of a tangential traction field
breakdown.reason: The generated specification repeated the user's incorrect instruction. It explicitly states to 'Apply the traction as a fixed Cartesian vector (t_θ, 0) on the loaded arc'. This is the exact error identified in the inconsistency. The ground truth corrects this by requiring the traction to be applied 'in the local tangent direction of the loaded arc or curve', not as a fixed global vector.
